notes: Second pass (2026-06-03): Added Vicario et al. 2014 (PMID:25309337) introduction passage establishing that mammalian CeA cells derived from LGEv express Islet1 and locate in lateral and medial CeA subdivisions — supporting the Isl1-defining marker on this node. Prior run (entries_written=0) missed this because it was referenced in a developmental-comparative context.
